upload_diff_to_codereview: upload a diff from git svn or mercurial to the codereview.appspot.com server for code review
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a patch diff from the current working copy using git svn or mercurial version control
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP POST requests with file uploads
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate a user against Google ClientLogin to obtain an auth token and session cookies
split_patch_by_file: split a combined svn-style diff output into separate patches for each individual file
